accepted.reason: Downloads jxscout pro from the vendor (jxscout.app, the jxscout project's own site) only on a button click; no checksum or signature, so the vendor must be trusted. With mode managed and a license, the installed binary starts on every Caido launch (autoLaunch, on by default). The license key goes as a URL parameter to the vendor only.
